title: 🎉 New Achievement Badge Released on CONNECT!
content:
We’re excited to introduce a brand-new badge on CONNECT — created to recognize your journey and active engagement as a CONNECT user!

* * *

![b0335f68ed0a49a3b0554d26db94934d](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/84c01235dae145079aa73ff34ddb3ff0/images/b0335f68ed0a49a3b0554d26db94934dRow%20%285%29.png)![e8b8148609134c87919b4165812b64af](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/84c01235dae145079aa73ff34ddb3ff0/images/e8b8148609134c87919b4165812b64afRow%20%284%29.png)![ffab3a207ede4d739db963ee87c8e6ab](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/84c01235dae145079aa73ff34ddb3ff0/images/ffab3a207ede4d739db963ee87c8e6abRow%20%283%29.png)![e95b5333ddf8421a848342ebf76bedd5](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/84c01235dae145079aa73ff34ddb3ff0/images/e95b5333ddf8421a848342ebf76bedd5Row%20%282%29.png)

* * *

**✨Why badges?**

Badges are our way of celebrating your growth, encouraging ongoing activity, and strengthening our community. They reflect your milestones and contributions on the platform.

**🔍Where to find it?**

Your badge is now visible on your Portfolio Page. Go check it out — and see what you’ve unlocked!

**Let’s create, share, and CONNECT!** ![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/84c01235dae145079aa73ff34ddb3ff0/images/d08bf26471a542c08fde606eaebe1e0eType%3DGetReady%2C%20Status%3DDefault.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/84c01235dae145079aa73ff34ddb3ff0/images/fb64e9e18e5f4b288527e2723b808908Type%3DGetReady%2C%20Status%3DDefault.png)

title: LiveSycn UNreal - CLO3d
content:
LiveSycn Unreal - CLO3d I am currently using the free trial of clo3d and wanted to try the livesync of clo3d with unreal, but my connection status is never tunring green is this due to the free trial ? can someone help me ? Thanks a lot!![05bba3b0de7b42ba9a3bd1896bb5c1b3](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/55490cbfb1df4a83b8ca6588b300248e/images/05bba3b0de7b42ba9a3bd1896bb5c1b3clounreal.png)


### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: thank you!! but i don't have the animation and livesync tab

Comment 2: Unreal 5.5.4CLO 2025.0.252
Reply 1: I was not able to replicate the issue, however, the connection issue should be addressed in the upcoming CLO patch release. You would just need to enable LiveSync in User Settings. This particular setting will be available after the patch release.

Comment 3: Hi yanick.horat,Thank you for trying out CLO and CLO LiveSync! I'm thinking that it could be a version compatibility issue but I want to be sure - could you let me know which version of CLO you are using? 🙂 The version number at the bottom left of the screenshot is not legible.Best regards,Bryan
content_description: "Seek assistance for troubleshooting LiveSync connectivity issues between CLO3D and Unreal while using the free trial version."
